pages.title: Neutronium Ingot
pages.text: One step past degenerate electrons: here the electrons have been pressed into the protons and only neutrons remain, packed shoulder to shoulder as in a neutron star. Something keeps it from springing back to ordinary matter, and I am grateful.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I first found bars of it stacked in an anomaly vault, already stabilised by someone who came before me. Working out how they held it together became the backbone of everything I built afterwards, and I have used it in nearly every machine since.

Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Found in$(): Anomaly Vault, Crashed Satellite, Fallout Shelter Stores, Observatory Ruin chests.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Horizon Simulation.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Absolute Notes II, Block of Neutronium, Bose-Einstein Condenser, Brane Shifter, Casimir Vacuum Press, Chronosteel Ingot, Coherent Wiring Harness, Computronium Ingot and more.
